content:
Overview

Drogheda is a city in Louth with a population of 44,000. A historic town on the Boyne River, known for the nearby UNESCO-listed Brú na Bóinne megalithic tombs, medieval St. Laurence’s Gate, and a growing commuter population. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Sunshine is limited, with about 145 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
